item.title: Interview: Jennifer Ho, commissioner, Minnesota Housing
item.description: Minnesota Housing Commissioner Jennifer Ho talks about her priorities for 2026 as well as federal uncertainty as it relates to housing funding and the increased presence of federal immigration officers in the Twin Cities.

item.title: Experts warn Fed nominee Warsh against reducing Fed holdings
item.description: Incoming Fed chair Kevin Warsh may want to shrink the Fed’s balance sheet, but analysts say market risks and liquidity needs make major cuts difficult.

item.title: U.S. manufacturing saw sizeable rebound in January
item.description: U.S. manufacturing grew in January as ISM PMI rose above 50, but tariffs lifted input costs, strained supply chains and threaten inflation and jobs.

item.title: Skilled trades gain advantage in U.S. labor market
item.description: Trade workers briefly outpaced college graduates in unemployment rates as AI disrupts white-collar jobs and drives interest in skilled trades.

item.title: Trump launches $12B critical minerals stockpile to counter China
item.description: Trump plans a $12 billion critical minerals stockpile to counter China’s influence, support U.S. automakers and secure lithium, rare earths and nickel.

item.title: YIMBY housing laws surge as experts debate affordability fix
item.description: As home prices soar nationwide, YIMBY housing laws gain momentum, but economists and activists dispute whether boosting supply can truly fix affordability.

item.title: Sustainable: Minneapolis microgrid initiative nears completion in 2026
item.description: Minneapolis microgrid and resiliency hub projects using solar and battery storage could be completed this year, boosting clean energy and outage resilience.

item.title: What businesses should know about ICE visits and workplace rights
item.description: As ICE and DHS activity increases in Minnesota, employers need to understand workplace rights, warrants, audits, and how to prepare for agent visits.

item.title: Landlords, activists worried as rent comes due amid ICE surge
item.description: Housing advocates urge Gov. Tim Walz to enact an eviction moratorium as immigration enforcement drives rent distress and housing instability.

item.title: Louisiana-Pacific proposes $157M plant in North Branch
item.description: Louisiana-Pacific plans a $157M wood products plant in North Branch, seeking Minnesota Forward Fund aid to create 100 jobs at its new flagship site.
